## Druggability (DGIdb / Open Targets) 
 
Categories: Cell Surface, Clinically Actionable, Druggable Genome, Kinase, Tyrosine Kinase 
### OpenTargets tractability 
 
| Modality | Tractable | Evidence | 
|---|---|---| 
| small molecule | yes | Approved Drug, High-Quality Ligand, Druggable Family | 
| antibody | yes | Advanced Clinical, GO CC high conf, UniProt loc med conf, UniProt SigP or TMHMM | 
| PROTAC | yes | UniProt Ubiquitination, Database Ubiquitination, Half-life Data, Small Molecule Binder | 
| other modality | yes | Approved Drug |
